subject: Urgent: production latency surge — audit evidence & token handling
messages:
From: Sarah Gold <sarah@fastretail.com>
To: support@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-04-14T22:18:00Z
Subject: Spike in 503s / 700ms median latency — need logs + exec note

Hi team,

Starting ~21:50 UTC we saw a sustained spike in token-generation latency across our production traffic (median 700ms, p95 > 2s) and an uptick in 503 errors. This impacted storefront search and personalization calls — we started routing to fallback at ~22:05.

We need the following within the next 4 hours so we can inform our execs and compliance team:
- Full production request logs (2027-04-14 21:45–22:15 UTC)
- Any backend error traces and stack dumps during the window
- Confirmation of whether customer tokens or raw request payloads were captured in logs or traces and how they will be redacted

This is urgent — ops+audits@fastretail.com and security@fastretail.com are copied. Please escalate.

Thanks,
Sarah
VP Engineering, FastRetail

Date: 2027-04-15T04:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in 503s / 700ms median latency — security handling + COC steps

Short answer: we will NOT share raw logs with unredacted tokens. Proposed secure artifact workflow (to meet audit needs and FastRetail's timeline):
1) Preserve original artifacts in the forensics bucket (immutably flagged, checksumed).
2) Compute SHA256 checksums and provide checksums-20270415.sha256 (already generated by SRE).
3) Create a redacted bundle: remove/zero-out Authorization and Cookie headers, keep token hashes (SHA256 of token) to prove presence without exposing secrets. Replace any request body PII with the string "[REDACTED]".
4) Produce a signed attestation PDF confirming redaction steps and time window; deliver via DocuSign.
5) If FastRetail requires a full forensics handover under NDA, open a controlled transfer under their legal request and ensure HSM/KMS access logs are attached.

Timeline: we can provide the redacted bundle + attestation within 6 hours; a controlled NDA handover would take 24–48 hours.

Also recommended: enable an immutable audit export (read-only) to FastRetail's S3 under a lifecycle of 30 days.

Mina
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
[signature: mina_haddad | Security & Compliance]
